categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Hello Tech Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the lithium-ion battery storage industry, focusing on the research, development, production, branding, sales, and services of lithium battery storage products and photovoltaic products. Its core product lines include portable energy storage devices, home energy storage systems, and photovoltaic solar panels, serving various scenarios such as outdoor travel, emergency preparedness, outdoor work, and residential use.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as CTB (Cell to Body) battery integration, high-efficiency lithium iron phosphate battery cells, intelligent BMS systems with multiple safety protections, and proprietary fast-charging technologies. It also innovates in photovoltaic technology with suspended integrated frame cage packaging and multi-curvature crystalline silicon solar cell encapsulation. Production processes include SMT patching, PCBA testing, battery processing, assembly, aging tests, and quality control systems like MES and QMS for automation and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global consumers with a focus on outdoor enthusiasts, emergency preparedness users, outdoor workers, and residential households seeking green energy solutions. Its products are widely used in outdoor recreation, disaster relief, outdoor operations, and home energy management. Major markets include North America, Asia (excluding China), Europe, and other regions, with sales channels spanning e-commerce platforms and large retail chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hello Tech operates globally with sales and subsidiaries in over 50 countries and regions, including China, the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom, Canada, South Korea, Australia, Singapore, and Mexico. It has established local subsidiaries and teams in key markets such as California (USA), Tokyo (Japan), Düsseldorf (Germany), and Seoul (South Korea) to enhance local operations and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales to end consumers. It controls the full value chain from R&D, production, branding, to global sales and after-sales services, adopting a direct-to-consumer (M2C) model that reduces intermediaries and enhances market responsiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Hello Tech emphasizes innovation in green, intelligent, safe, and user-friendly energy solutions, with significant R&D investment focused on portable and home energy storage, photovoltaic integration, and smart energy management systems. Key R&D projects include DIY small-scale home solar storage systems, high-power emergency backup systems, lightweight and high-efficiency solar panels, and advanced battery technologies such as sodium-ion and solid-state batteries. The company also prioritizes digital M2C operations and global brand expansion.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the direct sale of lithium battery storage products and photovoltaic solar panels via online platforms (brand websites, third-party e-commerce) and offline retail partnerships with major global retailers. It also earns income from related services and government subsidies. Investment income from cash management products contributes to non-operating income but is not sustainable revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hello Tech positions itself as a global leader in portable energy storage and full-scenario home green energy solutions, recognized as a pioneer and innovator in the industry. It competes with other lithium battery and solar energy companies worldwide, leveraging its strong brand 'Jackery,' extensive patent portfolio, and award-winning product design. The company maintains a competitive edge through continuous innovation, quality certifications, and a comprehensive global sales network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.61 billion, a 55.82% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 239.5 million, reversing previous losses with a 237.89% growth. The company’s asset base totaled about RMB 7.59 billion, with a steady increase in global sales volume surpassing 5 million units. It has demonstrated strong growth momentum, especially in overseas markets, with significant expansion in North America and Asia.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hello Tech emphasizes delivering affordable, green, intelligent, and safe energy solutions that are easy to use and highly reliable. Its products feature industry-leading battery integration technology, fast charging, high power output, and compact, lightweight designs. The company’s unique multi-curvature photovoltaic tiles combine aesthetics with high efficiency, and its integrated home energy systems offer all-in-one solutions. The brand is recognized for superior safety standards, international certifications, and a strong commitment to sustainability and social responsibility.
